title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: One yes: the storage plan you picked at 12:43 found 14.4 GB on the drives that nothing in the game or the tools uses, all of it downloadable again without your sign-in. (1) The old Parler voice program and its model, 8.8 GB on F and C (Sheila speaks with the Pocket voice since 27 October). (2) A set of accent recordings, 3.8 GB, that no tool reads. (3) The extracts from Kingdom Come II and Mafia, 1.8 GB, whose numbers are already written down. Kept on purpose: the approved cast's faces, everything the game reads, a voice setup that may not be rebuildable, and the lab folder. If the app's safety check stops the delete, the session will ask for your Allow at the PC the same hour.
sections.recommendation: Yes: F goes from 35 to about 46 GB free, comfortably above its 20 GB floor for this week's Kiln runs and builds.
